dinasbran_guide.text: You made it up the hill. Very good. The view is the reward. The hill is the entrance fee.
Dinas Brân sits on a hill about 300 metres up. The castle was built in the 1260s by the princes of Powys Fadog.
It was already a ruin within a couple of decades. The view, mercifully, has not changed.
The old stories say the hill hides a gwyllgi, a spectral black dog. I have never seen it. I have heard a lot of Labradors.
